blocks.text: In this lesson we’ll teach you the different kinds of letters and how to write them…

lines: 3. It is the *back of the envelope*.

blocks.text: When you go to the post office, it is because you need to send a letter, buy some stamps or some postcards.

blocks.title: Now, let’s write a letter to a friend…

items: – It is an informal letter and a private correspondence.
– Take a piece of paper and write a letter to a friend practicing the expressions in future tense (will – going to).

blocks.text: When a company sends a letter to another one, the secretary takes the dictation in shorthand and then she types it…

blocks.title: Write a letter to a company

items.q: Are you able to write a letter?
Could you send a letter to a company?
Is it important to know how to write the address in an envelope?
Were you able to write a personal letter?
What must you do if you don’t know the meaning of a word?
Must you try to do your best?
